title: For each RBAC action, list the action name, the variance of the subnet IP v
question: For each RBAC action, list the action name, the variance of the subnet IP version (IPv4 vs IPv6) across the subnets on the network that the RBAC entry refers to (considering only RBAC entries with action = 'access_as_shared' and public access where target_tenant = '*'), and the total number of distinct subnets involved. Do not repeat the action name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    nr.action AS action,
    s.ip_version AS ip_version,
    s.id AS subnet_id
  FROM networkrbacs AS nr
  JOIN subnets AS s
    ON nr.object_id = s.network_id
  WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND nr.target_tenant = '*'
),
per_action AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    VARIANCE(ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    ip_version_variance,
    distinct_subnet_count,
    LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action) AS prev_action
  FROM per_action
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN prev_action = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action,
  ip_version_variance,
  distinct_subnet_count
FROM ordered
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS action,
  VARIANCE(ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count
FROM base

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    nr.action AS action,
    s.ip_version AS ip_version,
    s.id AS subnet_id
  FROM networkrbacs AS nr
  JOIN subnets AS s
    ON nr.object_id = s.network_id
  WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND nr.target_tenant = '*'
),
per_action AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    VARIANCE(ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    ip_version_variance,
    distinct_subnet_count,
    LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action) AS prev_action
  FROM per_action
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN prev_action = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action,
  ip_version_variance,
  distinct_subnet_count
FROM ordered
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS action,
  VARIANCE(ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count
FROM base
